events.title: 선덜랜드 win promotion back to the Second Division at the first attempt with a 1–0 win over 포트 베일 at Vale Park .

포츠머스 lose 2–1 at home to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and are relegated from the First Division after just one season. 밀월 clinch the Second Division title with a 1–0 win over 헐 시티 at Boothferry Park and reach the First Division for the first time in their history.
On the final full day of the First Division season, 찰턴 애슬레틱 stay up with a 1–1 draw at 첼시, a result that sends their opponents into the relegation play-offs.

리버풀 finish their League campaign with a 1–1 draw against 루턴 타운. John Aldridge finishes the season as the First Division's top scorer with 27 league strikes for 리버풀, and 30 in all competitions. Brian McClair of 맨체스터 유나이티드, the division's next highest scorer, scores twice against 윔블던 to take his league tally to 24.
토트넘 홋스퍼 sell striker Clive Allen to Bordeaux of France for £1 million. 75-year-old 포츠머스 chairman John Deacon sells the club to Jim Gregory for £2million.
Aberdeen goalkeeper Jim Leighton links up with his former manager 알렉스 퍼거슨 by signing for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a £500,000 deal.

윔블던 pull off a major upset by beating 리버풀 1–0 in the FA Cup final . They have been First Division members for just two seasons and have only been a Football League side for the last eleven years. Lawrie Sanchez is 윔블던's goalscoring hero, while 리버풀 have a goal from Peter Beardsley disallowed and a penalty from John Aldridge saved by 윔블던 goalkeeper and captain Dave Beasant .

Kevin Clarke, 30, is sentenced to three years in prison after being found guilty of being the ring leader of a notorious gang of 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 hooligans who were involved in running battles with rivals fans, often in busy shopping areas.
Argentine midfielder Ossie Ardiles is given a free transfer by 토트넘 홋스퍼 after 10 years at the club.
애스턴 빌라 prepare for their First Division comeback by signing Derek Mountfield from 에버턴 for £425,000 and Chris Price from 블랙번 로버스 for £150,000.
미들즈브러 are promoted to the First Division, taking the place of 첼시, whom they beat 2–1 on aggregate in the play-off final.
울버햄프턴 원더러스 lift the Associate Members' Cup with a 2–0 win over 번리 in front of more than 80,000 fans at Wembley.
